insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in biliary and urinary systems
Chronic Renal Failure or end-stage Renal Failure or Chronic Liver Failure
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Top-up with annual aggregate deductible (Rs. 5L to Rs. 25L). Optional benefit to reduce PED waiting from 36 to 24 months.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to sum insured (once deductible exhausted)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Deductible applies on annual aggregate basis per policy year

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care treatments up to sum insured (pre/post limited to 30 days under day-care procedures)

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to sum insured; pre/post up to 60/90 days respectively

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to sum insured in any AYUSH hospital

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Inpatient donor expenses up to sum insured

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Rs. 3,000 per hospitalization (including app-based cab service to hospital)
ambulance_cover.notes: Not applicable for day care procedures

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Second Opinion for 22 specified critical illnesses, once per policy year
critical_illness_cover.notes: Reimbursement basis only with prior intimation

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Life Protect Benefit — additional 10% of sum insured per policy year for life-threatening conditions
restoration_benefit.notes: Available once per policy year; certification by treating practitioner required

disease_wise_sub_limits.home_care_treatment: Up to Rs. 50,000 per event and Rs. 1,00,000 per policy year per insured person

temporary_exclusions: pre-existing diseases (36 months, optional reduction to 24)
notable_exclusions_summary: Top-up plan with annual aggregate deductible (Rs. 5L-25L) and SI up to Rs. 95L. Pays only on exhaustion of deductible. Maternity, cosmetic surgery, refractive error and adventure sports excluded.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Royal Sundaram network hospitals (MediAssist TPA / Paramount TPA); reimbursement claims to be filed within 30 days of discharge. TAT pre-auth 1 hour, final bill 3 hours.
available_riders: Optional Reduction in PED waiting period (36 to 24 months)
